name: Stabilisation L1 (trajectoire optimale)
description: Applies Warp Stabilizer with the L1-optimal camera path (Grundmann et al., CVPR 2011, re-implemented from the paper): the path is made of still, pan and ease segments instead of a Gaussian blur of the shake, within the crop window allowed by « Crop Less <-> Smooth More ». Use « Stabilize, Crop, Auto-scale » framing (default) to hide the borders. No model, no download. Applies to the first selected clip.
author: FilmCraft
